summary: PromptVeer (pivot from TextVault) full backend + frontend regression. Backend: 28/28 pytest cases pass covering health, taxonomy (30 categories, 10 Mahabharata ranks), prompts CRUD (list/discover/get/create/update/delete with authorization), sort=trending|newest|top, filters, search, guest auth, /auth/me, like toggle (+ score recompute), share, library uploads/liked, profile with rank/progress/points_to_next, leaderboard. Frontend: all 5 tabs render on mobile viewport (Discover, Browse, Search, Library, Profile). Search debounce returns 3 results for 'marketing'. Prompt detail Copy works ('Copied' toast), Like works (159→160 with heart→❤️ and POST /api/prompts/{id}/like observed). Submit flow end-to-end works: creates the prompt via POST /api/prompts and it appears in Library > My Prompts. Profile shows Warrior name, Ghatotkach medal (Level 1), progress bar (0 pts to 30 → Satyaki), stats grid, and full 10-rank ladder. Two minor issues found: (1) Share button on web preview does not call POST /api/prompts/{id}/share because React Native Share.share() throws on web (works only on native); (2) After Publish, router.back() logs 'GO_BACK not handled by any navigator' — URL stays on /submit until user taps Cancel. No testID attributes exist on any interactive element, which hampers automation and violates the mobile testing guideline.

ui_bugs.issue: On web preview, React Native Share.share() throws and the subsequent api.sharePrompt() call is skipped, so shares count never increments and POST /api/prompts/{id}/share is never fired. Wrap in try/catch that still increments (or use navigator.share on web) so the backend share endpoint is called on all platforms.

After successful POST /api/prompts, router.back() emits 'The action GO_BACK was not handled by any navigator'. Toast shows but form stays on /submit. Use router.replace('/(tabs)/library') or router.dismiss() instead of router.back() when opened as a modal/root screen.

No testID attributes anywhere in the frontend (grep testID → 0 hits). Interactive elements (submit button, tab items, like/share Pressables, Copy button, category chips, search input, publish button) should have testID props per the mobile testing guideline. Automation currently relies on brittle emoji/text selectors.

issues: Like and Share icons in the sticky bottom bar are ~24-28pt Text; the whole Pressable is wider but the visible tap affordance is small. Consider explicit min-width/min-height 44 for the Pressable containers to meet the 44pt touch target guideline.

action_items: Fix share on web: wrap Share.share() in its own try/catch so api.sharePrompt() is always called, OR use navigator.share on Platform.OS === 'web'. Without this, the backend share endpoint is never invoked from the web preview.

Fix post-publish navigation in app/submit.tsx: replace router.back() with router.replace('/(tabs)/library') to avoid the 'GO_BACK not handled' warning and to actually leave the form after successful publish.

Add testID props to interactive elements across all tabs and screens per mobile testing guideline: tab bar items, +Submit button, category chips, sort pills, search input, prompt cards, like/share/copy buttons, publish button, library My Prompts/Liked tabs, profile rank rows.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py is ~670 lines — still within limits but approaching the 700-line threshold; consider splitting routers (auth, prompts, gamification) into separate modules.

get_optional_user() swallows all HTTPExceptions silently, which is correct for public endpoints but means invalid tokens on /prompts and /discover are treated as anonymous with no warning. Acceptable for MVP.
Rate limiter is in-memory only; will reset on backend restart and will not work across multiple replicas. Fine for MVP.
Consistent proper exclusion of Mongo _id via projection {"_id": 0} everywhere — good.
trending_score decrement on unlike goes negative-safe? update uses $inc: -3 which can push trending_score below 0; not a bug but ordering might behave oddly for new prompts. Consider $max clamp.
seed_data.py is loaded at import time and only inserts when db.prompts is empty; idempotent and safe.

rca_of_issue: Share on web: app/prompt/[id].tsx onShare calls `await Share.share(...)` from react-native. On web platform this API throws 'Share is not supported' (RN web has no Share polyfill in SDK 57). The catch swallows the error, and the following `await api.sharePrompt(...)` line is inside the try block — so the backend share call is skipped. Mitigation: (a) call api.sharePrompt() outside the try or before Share.share(), or (b) branch on Platform.OS: use navigator.share (or a simple copy-to-clipboard toast) on web, then always call api.sharePrompt().
